fusions.name: Rolling Swell
fusions.desc: Rolls a slow swell forward that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Barrel Roll
fusions.desc: Rolls a bubble of water at a target up to 5 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Bulk
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Recovery
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12. You regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
